connections.get.description: Get one WorkOS SSO or OAuth connection by ID via GET /connections/{connection_id}.
connections.get.title: Get connection

connections.list.description: List one page of WorkOS SSO and OAuth connections, optionally filtered by type, domain, organization, or name.

before.description: Object ID cursor for the previous page. Omit for the first page.

after.description: Object ID cursor for the next page. Official WorkOS `after` parameter.

next_cursor.description: Composio alias for `after`. Mapped to the official after query parameter.

limit.description: Maximum objects to return in this page (1-100). Defaults to 10.

order.description: Creation-time order. `normal` uses reversed cursor semantics.

domain.description: Return connections associated with this domain.

search.description: Text to match against connection names.

connection_type.description: Exact WorkOS connection type, such as OktaSAML or GoogleOAuth.

organization_id.description: Return connections associated with this WorkOS organization ID.

connections.list.title: List connections

directories.get.description: Get one WorkOS Directory Sync directory by ID via GET /directories/{directory_id}.
directories.get.title: Get directory

directories.list.description: List one page of WorkOS Directory Sync directories, optionally filtered by organization, name, or domain.

before.description: Object ID cursor for the previous page. Omit for the first page.

after.description: Object ID cursor for the next page. Official WorkOS `after` parameter.

next_cursor.description: Composio alias for `after`. Mapped to the official after query parameter.

limit.description: Maximum objects to return in this page (1-100). Defaults to 10.

order.description: Creation-time order. `normal` uses reversed cursor semantics.

domain.description: Return directories associated with this domain.

search.description: Text to match against directory names.

organization_id.description: Return directories associated with this WorkOS organization ID.

directories.list.title: List directories

directory_groups.get.description: Get one WorkOS Directory Sync group by its exact group ID via GET /directory_groups/{directory_group_id}.

directory_group_id.description: Exact WorkOS directory group ID to retrieve.

directory_groups.get.title: Get directory group

directory_groups.list.description: List one page of WorkOS Directory Sync groups for a directory, a directory user, or both.

before.description: Object ID cursor for the previous page. Omit for the first page.

after.description: Object ID cursor for the next page. Official WorkOS `after` parameter.

next_cursor.description: Composio alias for `after`. Mapped to the official after query parameter.

limit.description: Maximum objects to return in this page (1-100). Defaults to 10.

order.description: Creation-time order. `normal` uses reversed cursor semantics.

directory_id.description: WorkOS directory whose groups to list. Provide directory_id, directory_user_id, or both. Mapped to official `directory`.

directory_user_id.description: WorkOS directory user whose groups to list. Mapped to official `user`.

directory_groups.list.title: List directory groups

directory_users.get.description: Get one WorkOS Directory Sync user by exact ID via GET /directory_users/{directory_user_id}.

directory_user_id.description: Exact WorkOS directory user ID to retrieve.

directory_users.get.title: Get directory user

directory_users.list.description: List one page of WorkOS Directory Sync users for a directory or group, optionally filtering a directory by exact identity-provider ID or primary email.

before.description: Object ID cursor for the previous page. Omit for the first page.

after.description: Object ID cursor for the next page. Official WorkOS `after` parameter.

next_cursor.description: Composio alias for `after`. Mapped to the official after query parameter.

limit.description: Maximum objects to return in this page (1-100). Defaults to 10.

order.description: Creation-time order. `normal` uses reversed cursor semantics.

email.description: Exact primary email address to match. This filter requires directory_id.

idp_id.description: Exact identity-provider user ID to match. This filter requires directory_id.

directory_id.description: Directory whose users to list. Mapped to official `directory`. Required when filtering by idp_id or email.

directory_group_id.description: Directory group whose users to list. Mapped to official `group`.

directory_users.list.title: List directory users

invitations.get.description: Get WorkOS AuthKit invitation status and metadata by invitation ID. The acceptance token and URL are redacted.
invitations.get.title: Get invitation

invitations.list.description: List one page of WorkOS AuthKit invitations by organization or exact recipient email. Acceptance credentials are redacted.

before.description: Object ID cursor for the previous page. Omit for the first page.

after.description: Object ID cursor for the next page. Official WorkOS `after` parameter.

next_cursor.description: Composio alias for `after`. Mapped to the official after query parameter.

limit.description: Maximum objects to return in this page (1-100). Defaults to 10.

order.description: Creation-time order. `normal` uses reversed cursor semantics.

email.description: Exact recipient email address to match.

organization_id.description: Return invitations associated with this WorkOS organization ID.

invitations.list.title: List invitations

invitations.resend.description: Send another invitation email to the existing recipient of a pending WorkOS AuthKit invitation via POST /user_management/invitations/{invitation_id}/resend.

invitation_id.description: Pending WorkOS invitation to email again. Calling this tool sends a real email.

locale.description: Supported WorkOS locale for hosted invitation email rendering.

invitations.resend.title: Resend invitation

invitations.revoke.description: Revoke a pending AuthKit invitation so it can no longer be accepted via POST /user_management/invitations/{invitation_id}/revoke.
invitations.revoke.title: Revoke invitation

invitations.send.description: Create an AuthKit invitation and immediately send a real invitation email via POST /user_management/invitations.

email.description: Recipient email address. Calling this tool sends a real email.

locale.description: Supported WorkOS locale for hosted invitation email rendering.

role_slug.description: Role granted when the organization invitation is accepted.

expires_in_days.description: Number of days the invitation remains valid (1-30).

inviter_user_id.description: WorkOS user whose name will appear as the inviter in the email.

organization_id.description: WorkOS organization the recipient will join after accepting.

invitations.send.title: Send invitation

organization_memberships.create.description: Grant an AuthKit user active membership in an organization via POST /user_management/organization_memberships. An existing inactive membership is reactivated.

user_id.description: WorkOS user to grant organization access.

organization_id.description: WorkOS organization the user will join.

role_slug.description: One role slug to assign. Omit both role fields to use the default role; do not provide this with role_slugs.

role_slugs.description: Role slugs to assign when Multiple Roles is enabled. Do not provide this with role_slug.

organization_memberships.create.title: Create organization membership

organization_memberships.delete.description: Permanently remove an organization membership and its access via DELETE /user_management/organization_memberships/{membership_id}.

membership_id.description: Exact WorkOS organization membership ID to permanently delete.

organization_memberships.delete.title: Delete organization membership

organization_memberships.get.description: Get one WorkOS AuthKit organization membership by ID via GET /user_management/organization_memberships/{membership_id}.
organization_memberships.get.title: Get organization membership

organization_memberships.list.description: List one page of WorkOS AuthKit organization memberships for a specific organization or user, optionally including inactive or pending memberships.

before.description: Object ID cursor for the previous page. Omit for the first page.

after.description: Object ID cursor for the next page. Official WorkOS `after` parameter.

next_cursor.description: Composio alias for `after`. Mapped to the official after query parameter.

limit.description: Maximum objects to return in this page (1-100). Defaults to 10.

order.description: Creation-time order. `normal` uses reversed cursor semantics.

user_id.description: User whose memberships to list. Provide this or organization_id.

organization_id.description: Organization whose memberships to list. Provide this or user_id.

statuses.description: Membership statuses to include. WorkOS returns only active memberships when this filter is omitted.

organization_memberships.list.title: List organization memberships

organization_memberships.set_status.description: Activate or deactivate a WorkOS organization membership without deleting it. Maps to PUT .../reactivate or PUT .../deactivate.

membership_id.description: WorkOS organization membership whose access state will change.

status.description: Desired access state. Active reactivates an inactive membership; inactive deactivates an active membership. Pending is not supported.

organization_memberships.set_status.title: Set organization membership status

organization_memberships.update_roles.description: Replace the role assignment on an existing WorkOS organization membership via PUT /user_management/organization_memberships/{membership_id}.

membership_id.description: WorkOS organization membership ID whose roles will be replaced.

role_slug.description: One replacement role slug. Omit both role fields to use the default role; do not provide this with role_slugs.

role_slugs.description: Complete replacement role set for environments with Multiple Roles enabled.

organization_memberships.update_roles.title: Update organization membership roles
